zh: 我最近不得不忍受同事的无理取闹。
old_en: I've had to put up with my coworker's unreasonable behavior recently.
new_en: I've had to put up with my coworker's unreasonable behavior recently.

zh: 每天上班都要忍受上司的批评。
old_en: Every day at work, I have to put up with my boss's criticism.
new_en: Every day at work, I have to put up with my boss's criticism.

zh: 能不能不要总是忍受这种不公平的对待？
old_en: Can we not always have to put up with this unfair treatment?
new_en: Can we stop always putting up with this unfair treatment?

zh: 我希望公司能改进，让我们不用再忍受这些。
old_en: I hope the company will improve so we don't have to put up with these things anymore.
new_en: I hope the company improves so we don't have to put up with this anymore.
